title: To my dearly beloved Friends, The Inhabitants of the City of COVENTRY, Both Magistrates and People; ESPECIALLY Col. John Barker, and Col. Tho. Willoughby, late Governors, with all the Officers, and So

segments.text:
HUmbly beseeching the Lord on their behalf, that he will save them from that spirit of Pride, Hypocrisie, Dissention, and Giddiness, which is of late yeers gone forth, and is now destroying, and making havock of the Churches of Christ; And that he will teach them highly to
esteem those faithful Teachers whom the Lord hath made Rulers over them, 1 Thes. 5.12, 13. Heb. 13.7, 17. and to know them (so to be) and to obey them; And that he will keep them unspotted of the guilt of those sins, which in these days have been the shame of our Religion, and have made us a scandal or scorn to the World.
